name: Kingboard Holdings Limited
summary: Kingboard Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells laminates, printed circuit boards (PCBs), magnetic products, and chemicals in the People's Republic of China, Europe, Africa, the United States, and Other Asian countries. It operates through six segments: laminates, printed circuit boards (PCBs), chemicals, properties, investments, and others. The laminates segment offers PVB, epoxy resin, glass fabric, kraft paper for copper clad laminate, and electronic grade yarn.
